phoenixArea.definition: One inclusive Phoenix/Valley market covering 33 named communities plus blank-city records from Phoenix-specific trade and pool sources; blank locations still need verification.

arizonaNoWebsite.definition: Arizona businesses with at least one review, a callable phone, no website URL in the consolidated record, and an explicit no-site signal. Source-only gaps are not treated as proof.
arizonaNoWebsite.caution: Every record requires a same-day business-name and phone search before a website claim. The verify tier only means the source omitted a website.

arizonaPaidLeadBuyers.definition: Arizona home-service businesses with a public paid-advertiser or likely-active lead-platform signal. Ordinary directory listings are excluded from this queue.
arizonaPaidLeadBuyers.caution: A paid badge or Sponsored result confirms platform participation, not the advertiser's budget, profitability, or exact current spend. Website and Google fields are shown only when independently matched or explicitly verified.

cautions: Website and Google profile observations must be rechecked immediately before outreach.
AI firmographics are third-party estimates and workflows are not verified until a fit call.
Scores measure sales opportunity, not business quality, revenue, or purchase intent.
Real estate, property management, photography, chains, closed records, and reputation holds are excluded.
